date_only_rule.applies_when: The only temporal evidence for a contest is a calendar date, observed as a midnight UTC sentinel in the spine start field.
date_only_rule.logical_guarantee: A recorded calendar date may be a local date, so the true contest window lies within one day either side of it. Adding one further day covers the longest possible contest including overtime and weather suspension. A prior contest is therefore guaranteed complete before a target contest starts only when the target date is at least three days after the prior date.

cutoff_policy.label: THIS_IS_A_BOUND_NOT_AN_OBSERVED_FINAL_WHISTLE

published_start_instant_rule.applies_when: The spine carries a non-midnight UTC start instant for the contest.
published_start_instant_rule.logical_guarantee: A published start instant plus twelve hours bounds any contest including overtime, television delay and weather suspension. A prior contest is guaranteed complete before a target contest starts when the prior start instant plus twelve hours does not exceed the target start instant.

rejected_assumptions: Treating the retrieval time of a historical capture as the moment the value became known.
Treating a recorded calendar date as an exact kickoff instant.
Assuming that a prior contest on the immediately preceding calendar day had finished before a target contest began.
Imputing a poll publication instant from a poll week ordinal.

eligibility_rules.cutoff_rule: A prior contest contributes to a target row only when its precommitted completion bound does not exceed the target contest's earliest possible start.
eligibility_rules.future_append_invariance: A target row's emitted values depend only on contests whose completion bound precedes that target, so appending later contests cannot change an already-emitted row.
eligibility_rules.same_game_exclusion: A contest can never be its own prior, because its completion bound always exceeds its own earliest possible start.
eligibility_rules.tie_handling: A tie counts toward games played and toward neither wins nor losses.

excluded_domains.reason: The BAT-666 audit found no observed publication instant on either national route, so poll values have retrieval-time authority only.
The mutable dome and playing-surface attributes have retrieval-time authority only, and the audit rejected inheriting the geographic time-invariant basis for them.

gap_verdict.why: A nonzero slice now exists over the three audited domains, but rankings and the mutable venue attributes still lack any known-at authority, so the gap stays open and the protected lane stays closed.

leakage_exposure.interpretation: The bound removed no prior anywhere, because no team plays two contests inside the bound window. The conservative cutoff is therefore free at the team-prior grain: it costs no evidence while making every remaining value provably pre-kickoff.

win_rate_convention_difference.explanation: This slice counts a tie toward games played and toward neither wins nor losses, which the contract precommits. Where the spine used a different tie convention the rates differ even though the admitted prior counts are identical.
